region: EU (DE/AT price comparison; Alternate DE retail)
notes: Prices are the lowest listed EU offer on the date shown, not a quote. Stock and price move daily.
The 2026 DRAM/NAND shortage dominates the RAM line; the Gen5 9100 PRO is €264, the same price as the Gen4 990 PRO, so Gen5 is the default where the board has the port.
GPUs are owned by the user and excluded from platform totals; their replacement value is shown separately.
MCIO/SlimSAS cable prices are estimates; the drives/board are listed prices.

mainboard.name: ASRock WRX90 WS EVO (sTR5, WRX90, EEB, 7x PCIe 5.0 x16, 6 NVMe ports, IPMI)
mainboard.note: WRX90 + AST2600 IPMI; 1 Gen5 M.2 + 1 Gen4 M.2 + 2 Gen5 MCIO + 2 Gen4 SlimSAS.

cpu.name: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9955WX (16C/32T, 4.5-5.4 GHz, 350 W, 128 PCIe 5.0 lanes, 8-channel DDR5 ECC)
cpu.note: MSRP $1,649. Official memory: DDR5-6400, 8 channels, RDIMM.

ram_64gb.name: Samsung M321R8GA0PB0-CWM 64 GB DDR5-5600 CL46 2Rx4 ECC RDIMM
ram_64gb.note: 2 DIMMs = 2 of 8 channels now; 8 DIMMs = 512 GB octa-channel later. Modules are 5600; 6400 needs 6400-rated modules and QVL.

nvme_gen5_1tb.name: Samsung 9100 PRO 1 TB (PCIe 5.0 x4, 14,800/13,400 MB/s, 1.85M/2.6M IOPS)
nvme_gen5_1tb.note: Gen5 price parity with the Gen4 990 PRO (€264 vs €262); the default array drive.

nvme_gen4_1tb.name: Samsung 990 PRO 1 TB (PCIe 4.0 x4, 7,450/6,900 MB/s, 1.2M/1.55M IOPS)
nvme_gen4_1tb.note: Used for the 4× Gen4 and 6× Gen4 arrays; Gen4 thermals are easier under the GPUs.

sata_4tb.name: Samsung 870 EVO 4 TB SATA SSD
sata_4tb.note: OS partition + cold model archive; a 3 TB array image fits (3.6 TB usable), a 4 TB/6 TB array does not.

sata_8tb.name: Toshiba N300 8 TB SATA HDD (archive/image)
sata_8tb.note: Only for the 6 TB array: a full 6 TB image on ~7.2 TB usable; slow, cold archive.

mcio_cable.name: MCIO 8i/x4 to M.2 NVMe adapter cable
mcio_cable.note: 2 cables for the 3× Gen5 and 4× Gen4 arrays; 2 for the 6× Gen4 plus 2 SlimSAS.

slimsas_cable.name: SlimSAS SFF-8654 to NVMe adapter cable
slimsas_cable.note: Only for the 6× Gen4 array (2 SlimSAS ports).

psu.name: Seasonic PRIME PX-2200 (2200 W, ATX 3.1, 80+ Platinum, 2x native 12V-2x6 + 2x adapters, 4x PCIe 8-pin)
psu.note: 200-240 V only; 210 mm; 26% headroom over 1,630 W.

cooler_aio.name: SilverStone SST-XE360-TR5 (360 mm AIO, sTR5/SP6, 350 W class)
cooler_aio.note: Top-mounted exhaust; keeps CPU heat out of the GPU intake.

case_meshify.name: Fractal Design Meshify 2 XL (EEB 305x330, 9+3 slots, 6x 3.5", 2x 2.5", 250 mm PSU, 480 mm top rad)
case_meshify.note: Fits the EEB ASRock, four 2-slot GPUs, the 360 AIO and the 210 mm PSU.

fan_140.name: 140 mm PWM case fan (Fractal/Arctic class)
fan_140.note: Case includes 3x 140 mm; add bottom/rear fans for the M.2/GPU zone.

gpu_r9700.name: PowerColor Radeon AI PRO R9700 32 GB (2-slot blower, 267x111x40 mm, 300 W, 1x 12V-2x6)
gpu_r9700.note: OWNED by the user. Replacement value only; not in platform totals.

mainboard_trx50.name: GIGABYTE TRX50 AI TOP (TRX50 hybrid, 4x Gen5 M.2, no IPMI)
mainboard_trx50.note: For 4x Gen5 M.2 and no MCIO cabling; no BMC/IPMI.

mainboard_wrx90_aitop.name: GIGABYTE WRX90 AI TOP (WRX90, IPMI, 2 Gen5 M.2 + 1 Gen4 M.2 + 2 MCIO)
mainboard_wrx90_aitop.note: Announced 2026-10-30; no retail offers or price at the snapshot.
